Message.Name: Start Of End Of Day Message
Message.Description: The Start of End of Day message signals the start of Consolidated End of Day Summary and Participant End of Day Summary message iterations

Message.Name: End Of End Of Day Message
Message.Description: The End of End of Day message signals the end of Consolidated End of Day Summary and Participant End of Day Summary message iterations

Message.Name: Start Of Start Of Day Message
Message.Description: The Start of Start of Day message signals the end of Consolidated End of Day Summary and Participant End of Day Summary message iterations

Message.Name: End Of Start Of Day Message
Message.Description: The End of Start of Day message signals the start of Start of Day Summary message iterations

Message.Name: Start Of Day Message
Message.Description: The Start of Day message signals the start of normal data dissemination over the multicast lines

Message.Name: Reset Block Sequence Number Message
Message.Description: The Reset Block Sequence Number message is transmitted when the block sequence number on an output multicast line requires resetting.

Message.Name: Disaster Recovery Data Center Activation Message
Message.Description: The Disaster Recovery Data Center Activation message is transmitted to signify that the Consolidated Quotation System (CQS) has switched processing from the Primary Data Center to the Disaster Recovery Data Center

Message.Name: Line Integrity Message
Message.Description: The Line Integrity message is transmitted over the multicast lines at intervals of sixty (60) seconds to verify continued integrity of multicast transmission

Message.Name: End Of Day Message
Message.Description: The End of Day message is transmitted over the multicast lines to advise all Data Recipients that there are no further messages of any type transmitted for the day

Message.Name: Index Message
Message.Description: The Index message contains the index and the index value

Message.Name: Bid And Offer Index Message
Message.Description: The Bid and Offer Index message contains the index Bid and Offer index values

Message.Name: Market-Wide Circuit Breaker Decline Level Status Message
Message.Description: The Market-Wide Circuit Breaker Decline Level Status message is used to report the calculated Level 1, Level 2 and Level 3 threshold values for the current trading day necessary to trigger a circuit breaker

Message.Name: Market-Wide Circuit Breaker Status Message
Message.Description: The Market-Wide Circuit Breaker Status message is used to report the Market-Wide Circuit Breaker threshold Level that has been breached.

Message.Name: Approximate Adjusted Volume Market Center Message
Message.Description: Approximate Adjusted Volume Market Center message is used to report the volume of adjusted trading activity for each Participant.

Message.Name: Approximate Trades and Total Dollar Value Message
Message.Description: The Approximate Trades and Total Dollar Value message allows a Participant to report the total trades and total dollar value of trades at their respective market centers.

Message.Name: Crossing Session Summary Message
Message.Description: The Crossing Session message is used to report the total volume and dollar value of trades transacted after the close of a Participant’s regular session.

Message.Name: Prior Day Trade Correction Message
Message.Description: Prior Day messages are used to report CTA eligible Equity, Local Issue or Bond trades, corrections, cancels or errors for transactions that occurred earlier than the current trading day and had not been reported

Message.Name: Prior Day Trade Message
Message.Description: The Prior Day Trade message is used to report a Cta Equity, Local Issue or Bond transaction which occurred earlier than the current trading day and was not reported.

Field.Name: Prior Day Trade Date and Time

Message.Name: Prior Day Trade Cancel/Error Message
Message.Description: The Prior Day Trade message is used to report a Cta Equity, Local Issue or Bond transaction which occurred earlier than the current trading day and was not reported.

Field.Name: Prior Day Trade Date and Time

Message.Name: Consolidated Start of Day Summary Message
Message.Description: The Consolidated Start of Day Summary messages are transmitted shortly after the Multicast Line ‘Start of Day’ message

Message.Name: Participant Start of Day Summary Message
Message.Description: The Participant Start of Day Summary messages are transmitted shortly after the Multicast Line ‘Start of Day’ message

Message.Name: Consolidated End of Day Summary Message
Message.Description: The Consolidated End of Day Summary messages are transmitted shortly before the "Goodnight" messages

Message.Name: Participant End of Day Summary Message
Message.Description: The Participant End of Day Summary messages are transmitted shortly before the ‘Goodnight’ messages.

Message.Name: Auction Status Message
Message.Description: The Auction Status message is used when a Participant in a Cta eligible security, Local Issue or a Bond requires Auction Information

Message.Name: Trade Correction Message
Message.Description: The Trade Correction message is used to correct Cta eligible Equity, Local Issue or Bond information.

Message.Name: Long Trade Message
Message.Description: The Long Trade message is used to report trade information for Cta eligible Equity, Local Issue or Bonds.

Message.Name: Trading Status Message
Message.Description: The Trading Status message is transmitted when a Participant in a Cta eligible security, Local Issue or a Bond elects to notify CTS of an Opening Delay, a Trading Halt, a Trading Resume, a Price Indication or a Market Imbalance.

Field.Name: High Indication Price / Upper Limit Price Band
Low Indication Price / Lower Limit Price Band

Message.Name: Short Trade Message
Message.Description: The Short Trade message is used to report trade information for Cta eligible Equity only (not used for Local Issues or Bonds) if the trade meets message format requirements otherwise Long Trade message is used.

Message.Name: Trade Cancel/Error Message
Message.Description: The Trade Cancel/Error message is used cancel or error Cta eligible securities, Local Issues or Bond information.
